title: hieracium aurantiacum subsp. hinterhuberi
intro: Hieracium aurantiacum subsp. hinterhuberi, commonly known as Hieracium, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family and is native to the European Alps. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium aurantiacum subsp. hinterhuberi include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant actions, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
